answer: Storage pledges: every agent identity must hold 20 GB of random data derived from its own address and pass surprise retrieval checks seeded by each epoch's beacon. An honest agent pays a few dollars a month for that disk. A farm of 1,000 sybils must buy 20 TB of separate storage, a whole mesa of drives, or fail checks and forfeit its rewards. Hiding in one shared nebula of data doesn't help, since each slice is keyed to a different address.
